labels.label: Main scene rendering with deferred, composite and final passes (combined)

source: Original r5.9.3 archive; public Iris shadow-pass state and NeoForge render-stage boundaries
limits: Intervals between public boundaries may include multiple programs and engine work. Iris runs its deferred passes before translucent terrain and its composite and final passes before the after-level boundary, so the intervals ending at after_translucent_blocks and after_level contain that post-processing together with scene geometry. No per-pass, AO or reflection split, additive total or exclusive GPU occupancy claim. Option/dimension/graph changes require admission.
